rows.en:
I am the child of the sun! Kamen Rider BLACK RX!

Supreme commander of the Crisis Empire and strongest monster, Jark Midora! I won't let you have the Earth!

Jark Midora… I am thoroughly disappointed in you!

Even with all the power I gave you, you still cannot defeat the Kamen Riders!? Fight, and die…
Nngh… Your Majesty!

Jark Midora… no, General Jark!

Your misfortune was serving under an evil emperor!!

Jark Midora… no, General Jark!

Your misfortune was serving under an evil emperor!!

Jark Midora… no, General Jark!

Your misfortune was serving under an evil emperor!!

Jark Midora… no, General Jark!

Your misfortune was serving under an evil emperor!!

Your Majesty!

One last chance…! Please give me one last chance!!

Now then… this really is the end!

Supreme commander of the Crisis Empire and strongest monster, Jark Midora! Shall we see what you're made of?
…!? Apfaron! Wait!
…!? Apfaron! Wait!
…!? Apfaron! Wait!
…!? Apfaron! Wait!

Dasmader!

At this rate, General Jark will be killed! Rescue him!!

He is fighting the Kamen Riders with all his power!

If he should lose, then we truly have no further use for him!
That voice… Dasmader!?
Dasmader! All your wicked schemes on Earth… I won't let them go unpunished!!
Dasmader! All your wicked schemes on Earth… I can't let them go unpunished!!

…!?

Dasmader!? You were the Crisis Emperor!?
Defeat the strongest monster, Jark Midora!
Oyassan… the final battle is finally here, isn't it?

Leave it to us, Oyassan!

We beat the Crisis Empire! I don't know who this Steel Emperor Zephas or whatever is, but… we'll beat him for sure!

Ah…
Kotaro, don't worry about it… Steel Emperor Zephas is no father of mine! He's mankind's greatest enemy.
[HERO2]…

Well said, [HERO2]…

But listen… killing each other isn't our goal. Don't forget that, got it?
But… they told us to stand by until we get instructions…
Who cares! I'm the one saying it's fine! You lot need some rest too, don't you?
Mr. Tachibana…

Look!

With this many people crammed into the shop, I can barely find a seat myself…

The Battle Fleet Nation Naager has started its all-out attack, and there's no telling when we'll be called out! Taking it easy until then won't bring down any divine punishment, right?
What are you dawdling for? Get going!
Having lost much of its strength, the TDF was preparing to make one last stand against the Naager fortress, with the Science Patrol, MAT and every remaining force it had…

Yes, sir. According to the security team's report…

there doesn't seem to be any major movement yet. It remains quietly at a standstill.
Hmm… But we've already lost more than half our forces.

I hear Ultraman, who we were counting on, and our Ultraseven too have gone back to the M78 Nebula!

And at this crucial moment, no less…

We understand that…

But… can we really stand against them with only MAT's Ultraman, Giant Robo and Red Baron?

We understand that…

But… can we really stand against them with only MAT's Ultraman and Red Baron?

Yes, sir…

First, we launch a surprise attack on the space fortress to draw its attention!

In the meantime, we send an assault team into the space fortress to take control of the interior and blow up the Naager's power reactor.

But this is also an extremely dangerous gamble!

If it fails… we'll lose all our forces in an instant.
But… who's going to be the all-important assault team?
To strike the space fortress, we'll need to commit every force we have left! We'll have nothing to spare for an assault.
After all, we've got a former crew member of that ship on our side. He knows exactly where the power reactor is.
Former SIDO Director Sakomizu's… no, Steel Emperor Zephas's son, isn't he?
And besides… Takeshi, Hayato, Shiro, Kotaro, Goro, Ichiro, Jiro, and then…
In any case… we'll leave the assault team to you! However, should you fail…

What are you saying?

If you're afraid of failing, you can't do anything! We always fight believing we'll win!

If you've got time to worry about that, I'd like you to concentrate your forces properly so Takeshi and the others can get inside easier.

Understood… We'll do our best as well!

Director…
…It's begun!
Steel Emperor Zephas has begun his invasion!

Heh heh heh… Foolish Earthlings! Today is your final day…

Steel Emperor Zephas of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager begins his all-out attack! My Alien Legion and the BF will give their full cooperation to his invasion of Earth.

Heh heh heh… I'm counting on you!

Once that happens… Steel Emperor Zephas will become a nuisance too. But the time has not yet come… Go! Dracula!!

This is finally the last decisive battle!

The BF has thrown in every monster we've ever beaten! U7, we can't let our guard down!
A message from the undersea base! That thing is complete, sir. Please look at the footage.

Ooh… Magnificent workmanship!

Just what I'd expect from something our undersea base built with all its strength…

This robot is my life, my hope! I name it King Deviler!

Heh heh heh… Foolish Earthlings! I'll make today your final day…

Steel Emperor Zephas of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager begins his all-out attack! Our Iron Mask Party will also throw in its entire strength and give its full cooperation to his invasion of Earth.

Yes, sir!

We'll begin the attack immediately!! The Earth will belong to our Iron Mask Party…

Heh heh heh… I'm counting on you!

Once that happens, Steel Emperor Zephas will become a nuisance… but the time has not yet come! Go! King Deviler!!
A holiday…?
That's right… Mr. Tachibana decided it, apparently!
He probably did it to settle everyone's nerves before the final battle…
That's kind of him, Mr. Tachibana…

Hey, Gavan…

Let's just go home like this, together with Sharivan and Shaider? To Planet Bird…
What are you saying?

I'm worried…

I mean… if you fight this time, you might lose, right?
We won't lose! We'll win! I swear we'll win!!
I'm prepared…
Don't die, Gavan…
I'm immortal! Marine…
I want to go home to Planet Bird! Together with Gavan…
You mustn't say things that would shake Gavan's resolve!
Giant Robo!? So the all-out battle has finally begun?
Red Baron!? So the all-out battle has finally begun?
Hm? What's wrong?
I have just one request…

A request?

What on earth is the matter? [HERO4]…?

In this coming battle…

please, protect me no matter what, okay?

…!?

What's wrong? Why so formal all of a sudden… I'm always protecting you! You've got nothing to worry about!
Yes… I believe in you! In you, [HERO2]…

Hey, [HERO4]…

Do you remember that promise we made once?
When it's all over…

uncertain: U15544-U15547: 遺われた read as 使われた/仕えた ('serving under an evil emperor').
U15559: Kotaro concludes Dasmader is the Crisis Emperor; translated as written.
U15561-U15612: alternate-route copy of the B0171/B0172 scenes with different glyph noise; wording kept consistent with those batches.
U15563: 親父なんかじゃない rendered 'no father of mine'.
U15581: 元搭乗員 = the hero ([HERO2]), 'He knows' (male hero).
U15605: Retsu answers a line not present in this batch ('I'm prepared…').
U15601/U15608: バード星 rendered 'Planet Bird'.
